name: Watanabe Miyuki
source: Miyuki is the school's drama club president at Miyanomori High School. She's also a very devoted actor and tends to lose sense of herself and reality once on stage. Her obsession with theater and acting as well as her way of playing of different characters on stage has made her look like somewhat of an eccentric to other drama club members. After she heard about [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]girl transformation trouble[/url], she immediately invited him (her) to partake in the drama club's next play that deals with the theme of androgyny. She believes Takuya will be a perfect actor that they need for that play due to his circumstances.
